Hwæt! Did you know that you can study Old English at Northbridge?

Posted on 11 February 2024 by a student blogger.

I spent a term reading Beowulf in the original Old English, which is not a language requirement, not a proficiency test, and absolutely not on anybody's application checklist.

Why study Old English

The English department offers three terms of it. You will learn to pronounce sceal and to argue about kennings.
